# Pinterest

> > Visual discovery and inspiration platform for finding ideas across lifestyle, creative, and commercial content

Pinterest is a visual bookmarking platform where users discover and save ideas through Pins and boards. The site offers business tools including Pinterest Analytics, Pinterest Ads, and Pinterest API for developers, along with creator resources and shopping integrations.

## Key Topics

- Pins
- boards
- Pinterest API
- Pinterest Conversions API
- Pinterest Tag
- Pinterest Analytics
- Pinterest Ads
- home feed
- visual search
- content creation
- business accounts
- product catalogs
- audience insights
- Group boards
- Pinterest API for Shopping

## Core Platform

- [Pinterest](https://pinterest.com/_=_): Pinterest main landing page with login and signup authentication
- [Skip to content - Pinterest](https://pinterest.com/us): Pinterest homepage for discovering and saving ideas across multiple topics
- [Explore the best of Pinterest](https://au.pinterest.com/ideas): Browse Pinterest ideas by category: animals, art, beauty, food, and more
- [Today's Top Trends on Pinterest](https://pinterest.com/today): Daily curated trending content featuring fashion, quotes, and seasonal picks
- [Pinterest Analytics](https://analytics.pinterest.com): Pinterest Analytics platform for tracking Pin performance and engagement

## Business & Advertising

- [Pinterest Business](https://business.pinterest.com): Pinterest Business platform for ads, marketing tools, and brand growth
- [Pinterest Business - How Pinterest Works](https://business.pinterest.com/how-pinterest-works): How Pinterest works: visual discovery platform overview for businesses
- [Pinterest Ads](https://ads.pinterest.com/expert): Free Pinterest Ads consultation with experts for business growth

## Creators & Content

- [Pinterest Create](https://create.pinterest.com/creators): Pinterest for creators: tools, content formats, and monetization guide
- [Pinterest Content Academy](https://create.pinterest.com/content-academy): Pinterest Content Academy: creator-led video tutorials for success
- [Pinterest Create FAQ](https://create.pinterest.com/faq): Pinterest FAQ for creators, publishers, and brands on the platform

## Developer Resources

- [Pinterest Developers](https://developers.pinterest.com): Pinterest API documentation for conversions, content, ads, and shopping
- [Pinterest Developers Portal](https://dev.pinterest.com): Developer portal for Pinterest API, Conversions API, and Tag integration

## Help & Support

- [All about Pinterest](https://help.pinterest.com/en/guide/all-about-pinterest): Complete guide to Pinterest basics: Pins, boards, visual search features
- [Can't log in to Pinterest](https://help.pinterest.com/en/article/cant-log-in-to-pinterest): Login troubleshooting: password reset, account recovery, and access issues
- [Age verification](https://help.pinterest.com/en/article/age-verification-appeals): Age verification requirements and appeals process for Pinterest accounts

## Optional

- [Pinterest South Africa](https://za.pinterest.com/web/index/index): Pinterest web index landing page for South Africa with login/signup
- [All About Me Journal Ideas](https://pinterest.com/ideas/all-about-me-journal-ideas/923407027304): Curated collection of journaling ideas and all-about-me prompts
- [Templates About Me](https://pinterest.com/ideas/templates-about-me/948178477635): About-me templates for Instagram, education, and character sheets
- [About Us Ui Design](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/about-us-ui-design/955362027053): About-us page UI design inspiration and landing page templates
- [Makeup Tutorial Guide](https://pinterest.com/ideas/makeup-tutorial-guide/932355722317): Beginner makeup tutorials and step-by-step face makeup guides
- [Guides and Tutorials by Creately](https://ca.pinterest.com/creately/guides-and-tutorials): Creately's diagram tutorials: UML, flowcharts, and data visualization
